verdict.rationale: Pinecone's docs show dense-vector semantic search, with ranking via `score_by: dense_vector` and sparse-vector search over embeddings. A community comment notes Pinecone offered HNSW-based similarity search early, which supports the approximate nearest-neighbor part of the story. Nothing in the pack shows that the distance metric (e.g. cosine, euclidean, dot product) can be configured, so only about half the story is evidenced. missing for 10: documentation of configurable distance metrics, explicit first-party description of the ANN algorithm, hands-on corroboration of similarity search quality.
